concept.title: A Place to Pause, Breathe, and Belong
concept.p1: Inspired by the spirit of the dreaming horse—peaceful, untamed, and deeply connected—our space is a place to pause, breathe, and belong.
concept.p2: Crafted with local stone, warm wood, and natural linens, our six rooms reflect the earth's quiet strength. The soulful architecture offers inviting textures and shaded terraces to enjoy the golden light.
concept.p3: At the heart of the property, relax by the pool and waterfall jacuzzi under the palms. Enjoy ocean views just a short walk away, surrounded by birdsong and the scent of sun-warmed earth.

items.title: 6 Private Rooms
items.short: Six unique, comfortable spaces designed for deep rest.
items.desc: Six distinct rooms for up to 12 guests, with private bath, Wi-Fi, and A/C. Crafted with local wood and stone, ranging from luxurious King Suites to versatile Twin and Queen rooms, designed for a peaceful retreat.

items.title: Food Services
items.desc: Our in-house cook crafts dishes with an unmatched Mexican flavor using fresh, seasonal ingredients. You can bring your own ingredients or let us take care of everything. We offer breakfast, lunch, and dinner options for a complete culinary experience during your stay.

items.title: Pool, Jacuzzi & Lounge
items.short: Relax under the sun, enjoy the shade, or soak in the jacuzzi.
items.desc: Unwind in our spacious pool area. Whether you are swimming laps, reading under the palm trees, or letting the warm waters of the jacuzzi melt away your stress, this is your personal oasis.

items.title: Guest Kitchen
items.short: A collaborative space for your own culinary creations.
items.desc: Feel at home in our secondary guest kitchen. Fully equipped and always available for you to store your snacks, prepare a morning coffee, or cook your own meals.

items.title: Fast WiFi
items.desc: Whether you need to catch up on work or share your memories, enjoy reliable, high-speed internet access across all rooms and common areas.

items.title: Sunset Tour
items.short: Unforgettable Pacific views (included on 7+ day stays).
items.desc: For guests staying 7 nights or longer, we offer a complimentary guided sunset tour. Experience the breathtaking colors of the Nayarit coast from the best vantage points.

items.title: Rooftop Terrace
items.short: The perfect spot for stargazing and sea breezes.
items.desc: Head up to the rooftop terrace for panoramic views of the village and the ocean. It's the ideal setting for a morning yoga session or evening cocktails under the stars.

toursPage.heroTitle: UNIQUE ATV TOURS TO THE LESS EXPLORED SIGHTS IN CHACALA
toursPage.introText1: Venture where the maps end. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate the dense jungle canopy aboard our ATVs and cross hidden streams to uncover secrets the Riviera Nayarit keeps hidden. Every route is crafted to quicken your pulse and immerse you in the untamed beauty of our coastal paradise.
toursPage.infoCustomToursText: Large groups will often have special requests. A prepared lunch, breakfast en-route, extended time, or alternate routes can all be accommodated. Let us know your needs when booking.
toursPage.infoVehiclesText: We use Can-AM 6 seat ATV’s equipped with seatbelts for each passenger and catch nets. Daily checks are performed on each unit and maintenance is scheduled regularly.
infoBringItems: Water, snacks or lunch (if not included)

tours.title: Ojo de Agua
tours.description: Orchards leading to a pristine cold water spring. Discover hidden petroglyphs.
tours.longDescription: Ojo De Agua is a sweet water Jungle Paradise! Located relatively close to Chacala in distance we tour the area extensively before arriving. Turning south just outside of Chacala we transit through the beautiful Mango and Guanabana orchards of El Divisidaro and surrounding area. In the distance you can see the mountain town of Alta Vista as well as the beaches of Guayabitos & La Penita. This open air experience is sure to refresh your senses and get you reconnected with nature.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: Río Molote
tours.description: Thermal inlets and refreshing downstream river waters.
tours.longDescription: Mesillas is a small town 25km north of Chacala with a thermal spring river network. Leaving Chacala via highway 200 we travel 18 kms north to Mesillas. From Mesillas we descend to the valley floor using a series of mountain switchbacks. Once at the river we disembark and start our hike. The 1.5 km walk is a maze of thermal tributaries entering the main channel. There are a series of dug outs in the river that are used as wading pools. From here we drive out the valley floor over to Zacualpan witnessing some of the richest farmland in the state.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: El Capomo
tours.description: Natural plunge pool under a majestic 50ft jungle waterfall.
tours.longDescription: This tour to the farming community of El Capomo is the perfect opportunity to get in the water and cool down. We ride cross country through the orchards of El Divisidaro to get to the town of El Capomo where we do a quick tour of town. Then it is off into the foothills where we parallel the lazy river until we come to our parking area. El Capomo falls requires you to walk up the river bed for approximately 1km until we reach the plunge pool where you can swim under the falls.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: Las Cuevas
tours.description: Hidden gem under a volcanic plug for uninterrupted beach time.
tours.longDescription: Located 1hr. ride from Chacala this relatively unknown beach is a place where water has mixed with fire and both have left their mark upon the earth. Volcanic rock litters the area and the lava that once flowed here is still visible. Nestled in a cove below a volcanic plug the energy of the earth is strong and practitioners looking to perform energy type work will want to scout this location. Los Cuevas is Ideal for groups looking to spend some time at the beach without a lot of interference.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: Jumurrca
tours.description: Explore hidden paths and spectacular views of local wildlife.
tours.longDescription: Jumurrca Agua's Terminales is a beautiful up to date modern facility. Jumurrca boasts 2 main pools, an upper hot tub and 2 lower wading pools with sun shades for kids of all ages. This facility has cabana style shelters paralleling both sides of the pool areas. There are several grassy areas with walk ways creating separation allowing for privacy. At the far end of the facility there is a beautiful common area with high palm trees producing shade. No chemical is added to the waters and pools are flushed regularly.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: Alta Vista
tours.description: Ancient petroglyphs and sacred sites hidden in Nayarit's lush jungle.
tours.longDescription: Alta Vista is a Petroglyph Complex originating at a time that existed before recorded history. This site has been used by peoples' seeking spiritual connection and enlightenment for thousands of years. The carvings on these rocks are indicators of the energies that exist in nature and double as seasonal calendars. Also at this site is evidence of the Spanish conquest of Mexico dating to the early 16th century. This is a must see location for anyone interested in ancient cultures and civilizations.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

tours.title: Volcano Sunset
tours.description: Conquer the crater and experience breathtaking panoramic sunset views.
tours.longDescription: If you are visiting Chacala you definitely do not want to miss out on the most magical time of day... Sunset !!! Chacala Adventure Tours does a beautiful evening cruise through the jungle and orchards of Chacala to the top of the Volcano that over looks Chacala Bay. From here you have an unobstructed view of a spectacle that can last more than 30 minutes. Watch as the energies of Sun and Moon dance upon the water and reflect in the sky as the stars come to greet the evening.
tours.capacity: Maximum 5 passengers per unit (up to 10 per group)

toursPage.editorialText: Experience the untamed beauty of Riviera Nayarit. Our off-road expeditions are designed to connect you deeply with nature while preserving its pristine condition.

items.a: Chacala has about 300 full time resident with the population surging during Christmas and Semana Santa. Our town is very small, situated primarily around a small Bay and most hotels/residence are within a 6 minute walk of the beach.

Yes, we have a fully stocked shared kitchen with full size appliances and most of the amenities you would find at home. Each room is also equipped with a mini fridge/microwave. We also have a BBQ available on request.
We highly recommend DEET to repel mosquitoes. Smaller insects such as midges come out in the cooler hours of the evening.

items.q: What is the capacity of your Casa?
items.a: We can accommodate up to 12 people.

items.q: How do I get there from the airport?
items.a: You can rent a car or take a bus or taxi. We can assist with your arrangements.

items.q: Is there a drug store nearby?
items.a: There are several drug stores in Las Varas (10km from Chacala).
There is a hospital in nearby Las Varas (10 km from Chacala) as well as a medical clinic that is open Monday - Friday 8am - 4 pm.
Chacala has 3 bank machines and there are several large banks in nearby Las Varas.
We have several small grocers in Chacala, and larger grocery stores in nearby Las Varas.
Our town always has construction going on during the day, but evenings are normally quiet. Our Casa is closer to the jungle on the outskirts and tend to be quieter.

location.title: Discover Chacala
location.subtitle: Location
location.intro1: Hidden in a small cove along the Pacific coast in the state of Nayarit, Chacala stands out for its unique charm and pristine beauty. Providing a serene getaway, the village boasts uncrowded beaches and a welcoming atmosphere.
location.intro2: The town's name, meaning "where there are shrimp" in Nahuatl, reflects its connection to local culture and abundant marine life, adding to the distinctive character of this coastal gem.
